mentions.name: Local-first AI agent desktop app
mentions.description: This desktop app bundles an AI model with a local-first agent so users can run AI on their own files without anything leaving their machine. It is aimed at people who cannot use cloud AI agents because of privacy concerns or company policy.
mentions.problem: Many non-technical people cannot use AI agents at all, either because they don't want to share private data with services like ChatGPT or because company policy prohibits it.
mentions.audience: Non-technical people, including professionals who handle sensitive files such as contracts, client records, financials, and HR docs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Desktop app bundled with an ai model and a local-first agent so nothing leaves your machine.
mentions.author: simquat
